svg.aria-label: Notebook page. Priyanshu Kumar Senapati, B.Tech CSE (AI and ML) at RV University, class of 2028, Bengaluru. 'I build AI that is always right' is crossed out and corrected to 'knows when it's wrong'. Sticky note: RescueLens, 94.55% top-1; shown 60 cars it had never seen, it said not sure 58 times instead of guessing. Tally: 10 hackathons, 2 made the finale. A sketched car marks where the high voltage runs.
